title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature is crucial for handling JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling yantraverse to support a wider range of use cases and improving its overall versatility. It will provide a robust way to parse request bodies, handling errors and edge cases. This will enhance the framework's usability and make it more appealing to developers
testCases: Test error handling for invalid request bodies
acceptance: Request body parsing should work correctly for JSON and URL-encoded bodies, handle errors, and be fully documented
reason: This feature is essential for a production-ready framework, as it will allow developers to handle various types of request data, making yantraverse more competitive and useful in real-world applications
